glosses: A person who is intoxicated, especially one who is habitually drunk.

examples.text: As he walked along, the inebriate, whose gait was at first unsteady, recovered his equilibrium and required less help.

To disorder the senses of; to exhilarate, elate or stupefy as if by spirituous drink.
